evidence: The substrate temperature during deposition was fixed at 136 3C. Diethylzinc (DEZ) and H2O reactant gases were alternately fed into the growth chamber with argon as a carrier gas. The typical pulse lengths were 2s for the reactants and 8 s for the evacuation between the reactants. The UV light was irradiated onto the substrate through the top quartz window of the chamber. A low-pressure mercury lamp was employed as a light source, radiating intense 184.9 and 253.7nm resonance lines.
